notes: Off. The toolkit sends nothing anywhere by itself, and this file is where that stops being a claim and becomes a setting you can read.
'enabled': false means no outbound connection is attempted at all - findings are written to the store and to logs/ and stay there. Everything in this quickstart works with delivery off.

To turn it on later you need three things: a bot token in the encrypted secret store, its reference in data/bot_telegram.json, and at least one chat in data/telegram_groups.json. See docs/07_telegram_app.md.
